set.body:
Objective
Make sketched-ar.Rmd an evidence-backed guide to SRHT, IHS, parcel pooling, and Nyström extension.

Required work
- Diagnose the landmark result whose rendered full-map correlation is approximately 0.016.
- Compare like-for-like coefficients, noise treatment, and estimator targets.
- Replace the current greater-than-0.01 regression threshold with a scientifically meaningful fidelity contract.
- Use the current public pooling syntax and clearly distinguish any legacy by_cluster compatibility route.
- Measure runtime on a declared problem size before claiming large speedups, or qualify/remove the claim.
- Calibrate language such as indistinguishable against measured error.

Acceptance criteria
- The Nyström section either meets a predeclared fidelity and error threshold or explicitly documents the limitation without claiming faithful recovery.
- Tests check correlation plus at least one scale-sensitive map error.
- Runtime claims include reproducible timing methodology and outputs, or are removed.
- All examples use current public engine, lowrank, and noise configuration.
- The vignette renders deterministically from current source.
set.title: Repair or retract Nyström fidelity and sketched-GLM performance claims
